name: Validate Postcode
description: Is this a postcode or ZIP code for the country? Knows US, GB, CA, DE, FR, IN, AU, SG, NL, JP and BR; answers { valid, value } or { valid: false, reason } — a shipping address, a billing address, a delivery form. A country without a rule accepts any non-empty value and says so.

data.assignments: [{"variable":"result","value":"{{= (() => { const s = String(postcode ?? '').trim().toUpperCase(); const c = String(country || 'US').toUpperCase(); const rules = { US: /^\\d{5}(-\\d{4})?$/, GB: /^[A-Z]{1,2}\\d[A-Z\\d]? ?\\d[A-Z]{2}$/, CA: /^[A-Z]\\d[A-Z] ?\\d[A-Z]\\d$/, DE: /^\\d{5}$/, FR: /^\\d{5}$/, IN: /^\\d{6}$/, AU: /^\\d{4}$/, SG: /^\\d{6}$/, NL: /^\\d{4} ?[A-Z]{2}$/, JP: /^\\d{3}-?\\d{4}$/, BR: /^\\d{5}-?\\d{3}$/ }; const rule = rules[c]; if (!rule) return s ? { valid: true, value: s, note: 'No rule for ' + c } : { valid: false, reason: 'Empty' }; return rule.test(s) ? { valid: true, value: s } : { valid: false, reason: 'Not a ' + c + ' postcode' }; })() }}"}]
